name: Morse.indexM
hypotheses: model space E finite-dimensional (the textbook's finite-dimensional manifold); no criticality needed
difference: Same Hessian at every point; the only difference is the index of a form in infinite dimension (sigNeg = 0 vs the blind sSup). On M = E = ℓ²(ℕ), f x = -x₀² at 0: project index 0, blind index 1.
why: Hessians agree outright (preferred chart), indices agree in finite dimension. The counterexample needs an infinite-dimensional model, outside the textbook's hypotheses; the project's theorems about indexM all assume FiniteDimensional ℝ E.
